title: rest: the dataset query door answers 404 "not found" when the saved-dataset read itself failed
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKZzp4DLtqiCkZZRM

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named seam and a measured reach (out-of-scope finding of #31589's os-dev-report 6731447318, open question 4). ⛔ Not a claim.
reach: read on `main` `c2bb879f`: `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts:199` reads the saved datasets with `p.getMetaItems?.(datasetRequest).catch(() => null)`, then treats the empty list as absence and returns `404 NOT_FOUND "Dataset … not found."`. The AI tool `query_dataset` (#31589, PR #31772) answers the same failed read `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, because a degraded read is not absence. Not measured live.
Business reason: when the metadata read fails (backend down, a timeout), a dashboard or report built on a saved dataset tells the user the dataset does not exist. The user may delete or rebuild something that is still there, and an operator reading logs sees a 404 instead of an outage. The two doors over one dataset also disagree.
Reader: the next `domain:server` seat, from `pm:queue`, after PR #31772 merges.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `analytics dataset not found catch null getMetaItems`, `dataset door 404 failed read` → nothing on point.
class: a · type: Bug
Grade: p3. Wrong status during an outage; no wrong data is served.

## 维护者速读

数据集查询接口在读取已保存数据集失败时（比如元数据后端不可用），会回答“数据集不存在”(404)，而不是“服务暂不可用”(503)。用户可能因此误以为数据集被删了。AI 工具那一侧已经按 503 处理，这张卡让 REST 接口也一致。

## What to build

1. `analytics-routes.ts`: a failed saved-dataset read answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (ADR-0112 coded, naming the read that failed), never `404`. A read that succeeds and lacks the name stays `404 NOT_FOUND` unchanged. ⛔ No catch that turns a throw into an empty list.
2. Tests: a throwing `getMetaItems` → 503, RED on main (404) and GREEN after. CONTROL: a successful read without the name → 404, unchanged; a found dataset → served as before.

## Surface

- Expected file surface: `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`, tests, root `.changeset/`.
- Clause-②: no.

Related: #31589.
